tagImport.title: Import tags
tagImport.subtitle: From an Excel or CSV sheet: see what happens row by row before anything is saved.
tagImport.drop: Drop the file here, or click to choose it
tagImport.drop_hint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, with a header row. Columns are recognised in English or Italian.
tagImport.template_desc: Download the template: it has the right columns, examples with addresses in the {{driver}} driver's format, and an instructions sheet.
tagImport.fix_first_one: {{count}} row needs fixing: while there is an error nothing is saved.
tagImport.fix_first_other: {{count}} rows need fixing: while there is an error nothing is saved.
tagImport.nothing_to_do: The file matches the existing tags: nothing to import.
tagImport.changed_since_preview: The tags changed in the meantime: check the preview again.
tagImport.text_desc: Paste the declarations exported from TIA Portal or Codesys, one per line:
tagImport.text_types: Accepted types: BOOL, INT, DINT, REAL, STRING. S7: DB1.DBX0.0, DB1.DBW4, DB1.DBD8, M10.0. Modbus: 40001, 30001, 00001, 10001.
tagImport.text_historize: Enable history for every imported tag
tagImport.text_nothing: Nothing was imported: fix the lines below and try again.

problem.bad_type: Type “{{value}}” is not valid: use BOOL, INT, DINT, REAL or STRING
problem.duplicate_address: Address already used on row {{value}} of this file
problem.scaling_range: Scaling: raw min and raw max cannot be equal
problem.decimals_range: Decimals: a whole number from 0 to 10
problem.unknown_column: Column “{{value}}” not recognised: it is ignored
problem.too_many_rows: Too many rows: at most {{value}} at a time
problem.unreadable_file: The file cannot be read: save it as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV ({{value}})
problem.udt_managed: Tag generated by a UDT instance: edit it from the UDT type
